summary: Iteration 21 — Two-Lane (Creator vs Gamer) ecosystem + Backstage AI + Catalog gate + Spectator hub. Backend: 17/17 pytest PASS (100%) on /api/lanes/set + /api/lanes/{user_id} (creator/gamer/invalid/unknown-user defaults), /api/catalog/status (target=3000, gate_strategy='deterministic_hash_80pct'), /api/catalog/in/{track_id} (in_catalog/requires_ownership boolean inverse), /api/catalog/seed (returns seeded=2800 = 800 mtv + 600 mos + 800 hh + 600 ar across 4 whitelisted genres, idempotent upsert), /api/backstage/motivation returns 3 lines for all 4 styles (rock_legend, hiphop_pioneer, mtv_icon, mos_dj) + invalid style falls back to rock_legend, /api/gamer/recordings POST creates doc with lane='gamer'+is_private=true+share_to_social=false (HARD locked), /api/gamer/recordings/{user_id} returns user's private recordings (no _id leak), /api/spectator/hub returns reality_sets[] + gamer_sets[] arrays AND gamer_sets entries do NOT leak blob_url (privacy-safe spectator view confirmed). Emergent LLM Claude Sonnet 4.5 LIVE & HEALTHY: manual probe with 'Bohemian Rhapsody'/Queen returned 3 vivid in-persona lines ALL is_ai=true (e.g. 'Listen darling, when you hit that first "Mama, just killed a man," the audience needs to feel the weight...'). Frontend (mobile portrait 430x932): Lane toggle pill [data-testid='lane-toggle'] visible in sticky bottom-nav AT ALL TIMES on both lanes with [data-testid='lane-toggle-creator'] + [data-testid='lane-toggle-gamer']; clicking gamer toggle switches lane (POSTs /api/lanes/set, persists localStorage 'pp_lane') and routes to [data-testid='gamer-page'] showing 'Gamer Lane / Private mode — Recordings stay yours. No social posting, no battles' banner, [data-testid='gamer-search-input'], [data-testid='gamer-recents-empty'] state, and 'Tracks outside the curated 3,000 require ownership' gate copy. Bottom nav items correctly swap to gamer-set on lane toggle (Gamer/Hub/Tracks/Backstage/Stage/Profile). [data-testid='backstage-screen'] mounts from nav-backstage with [data-testid='backstage-lines'] container + 4 style picker buttons [data-testid^='backstage-style-'] (rock_legend active by default, hip-hop, mtv, mos_dj options visible), [data-testid='backstage-line-0'] streams in within ~5s with REAL AI text in bold neon-green calligraphy + 'AI' tag, [data-testid='backstage-take-stage-btn'] correctly DISABLED while loading then ENABLED after first line appears. NOT FULLY UI-VALIDATED (data-testids exist in source per grep but render is gated): RecordingStudio.js line 139 `if (!song) return <RecordSearchScreen>` — [data-testid='recording-studio'] + host-frame + collab-grid + viewer-layout + floating-comments + calligraphy-lyrics only mount once currentSong is set (same as iter-20 finding). BeatMaker requires a song loaded into PlayerStudio first (the 'Start Original' button shows stems-upload screen). Code review confirms portrait layout in source: host-frame (flex-[55] top, aspect-[9/16]) → collab-grid (flex-[20] horizontal scroll) → controls below; FloatingComments fixed left (max-w-[120px]), CalligraphyLyrics fixed right.

frontend_issues.minor_ux_observation: On full page reload, even when localStorage 'pp_lane'='gamer', App.js initializes currentView='stream' (HomePage view) — the lane toggle pill correctly shows GAMER active but the gamer landing page only renders after another nav click. Consider syncing initial currentView to lane: if (pp_lane==='gamer') default to 'gamer'. Not a regression — purely a polish item.

action_items: VERIFY (main agent self-test, optional): Load a track first via Stream row click → click nav-record → assert all portrait Stage testids (host-frame above collab-grid, floating-comments left half, calligraphy-lyrics right half). Source already validates the layout; live screenshot just requires the song-loaded entry path.
POLISH (optional): App.js useState initializer for currentView could honor lane=gamer → default to 'gamer' view on reload (minor UX consistency).
critical_code_review_comments: lanes.py: /catalog/seed loops with await per upsert (2800 round-trips) — fine for one-time seed but should use bulk_write(UpdateMany ordered=false) if invoked frequently. Currently ~5-10s end-to-end which is acceptable for an idempotent admin op.

lanes.py: _llm_motivation is called 3× sequentially inside /backstage/motivation. Could be asyncio.gather'd for ~3× speedup (currently ~30s for 3 Claude calls). Trade-off: simpler error handling per-line.

lanes.py L168: deterministic hash 80/20 gate is reasonable for a stub but track ids like 'mtv_seed_*' that ARE in db.curated_catalog correctly override via L188-190 — good. Production would need a real catalog manifest import job.

lanes.py /spectator/hub: gamer_sets correctly projects-out blob_url at the Mongo level ({'_id':0,'blob_url':0}) AND the assembled performer_handle masks user_id to first 6 chars — privacy is enforced. Good.
lanes.py /gamer/recordings: doc.copy() before insert_one (L262) avoids Mongo mutating the dict with _id — good pattern for the doc-returned-to-client.

App.js L28-32: currentView initial state ignores localStorage 'pp_lane'. Minor: on reload with pp_lane=gamer, user lands on Stream (creator view) until they manually navigate or toggle. Suggest reading pp_lane in the initializer.

RecordingStudio.js: data-testid='recording-studio' is gated by L139 `if (!song) return <RecordSearchScreen>`. For automated testing, consider adding data-testid='record-search-screen' on the empty state too — would make UI tests deterministic without song-loading prerequisite.
BackstageScreen.js: AI 'AI' tag (L93/L100) correctly distinguishes is_ai=true vs fallback. Good.
BottomNav.js: GAMER_ITEMS has 'record' key with label 'Stage' — same key 'record' in both lanes (just relabeled), so handleNavigate works consistently. Good.

Two-Lane catalog gate: /catalog/in/{track_id} is the right enforcement seam. Frontend should call this before any track is opened on gamer-lane to surface the $79.98 AUD ownership upgrade — verify GamerPage.js wires this before pickTrack.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on lane toggle + GamerPage + BackstageScreen (with real Claude Sonnet 4.5 streamed line + AI tag + 4 styles + take-stage enable transition). RecordingStudio/BeatMaker portrait layout testids exist + source-confirmed but render is gated by currentSong != null (smoke didn't load a song before navigating to record).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app && set -a && source frontend/.env && set +a && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_iteration21_two_lane.py -v (17 tests, ~60s due to 4 sequential Claude calls in TestBackstage). All backend endpoints under /api/lanes, /api/catalog, /api/backstage, /api/gamer, /api/spectator are stable. Frontend MUST be tested at viewport 430x932 (mobile portrait). Lane toggle is in bottom-nav above the items row. To reach RecordingStudio mounted state: either (a) Stream tab → click track-row-0 → 'Open in Studio' (then Record), or (b) Gamer tab → search → pick track → Take Stage from Backstage. Backstage take-stage-btn is disabled until backstage-line-0 fades in (~3-6s after API response, lines reveal staggered at 800ms/each).
rca of the issue: No bugs. All iteration-21 backend acceptance criteria pass end-to-end. LLM is_ai=true confirmed on Claude Sonnet 4.5 calls. Frontend lane toggle, GamerPage, BackstageScreen all live-validated with real network calls + real AI text. RecordingStudio portrait layout testids verified in source (host-frame above collab-grid in flex-col stadium layout, floating-comments fixed-left, calligraphy-lyrics fixed-right) but a quick UI smoke that lands on /record without a pre-loaded currentSong correctly falls through to RecordSearchScreen — this is intentional behavior, NOT a bug. The unified-playback 'auto-switch to Viewer view' after gamer session is implemented via App.js L149: setCurrentView('record') keeps user on RecordingStudio whose layout toggle exposes Viewer mode.
